questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of grassland habitats?

questions.stem: What adaptation helps the baobab tree survive in the desert?

distractorRationale.a: Large leaves would lead to more water loss in the desert.
distractorRationale.c: Frequent flowering is not a key adaptation for desert survival.
distractorRationale.d: Shallow roots would not be effective in searching for water in dry soil.
